purpose: IFS Cloud authoritative API and routing evidence promotion.

patch.evidenceNote: IFS documentation establishes OAuth2 REST/OData projections discoverable in API Explorer with OpenAPI v2/v3 and OData metadata. Premium APIs are preferred for stable scenarios. Client Credentials uses a service account and bearer access tokens. Projection permission sets support Read Only access and Data Access Control can further restrict entity data. No sandbox or customer tenant was authenticated and no live read round-trip was performed.

providerIdentity.regionalHostModel: customer-specific IFS Cloud system URL and provider/customer deployment region

privateLegacyOrAdjacentSources.endpointModel: separate private source or middleware route

regionalRouting.residencyEvidence: authorised tenant and provider/customer deployment evidence required

governedReadProjection.preferredSurface: Premium API or exact reviewed read-only projection

bootstrapAuthority.purpose: optional Entity Service activation or IAM setup

securityEvidenceBlockers: IFS projections may expose mutation actions; WFM requires a dedicated service identity with exact Read Only projection grants and observed denied mutations before evidence advances.
Projection access alone does not prove company/site/entity isolation; effective Data Access Control or an equivalently constrained projection must be observed where source scope needs narrowing.
Entity Service activation is customer-controlled setup and does not become steady-state runtime authority.

Exact system URL, deployment region, projection versions, paging/delta behaviour, rate limits and custom schemas are tenant/release dependent and must be discovered without cross-host or cross-region inference.
No generic event completeness contract is claimed for all IFS projections; bounded reads and reconciliation remain the completeness path.
